_comment: The apps on /apps. availability: request (a Request access button) or personal (no button). repo: the GitHub URL once the code is public, else null. shots: for each look of the site, [front, back] pictures from empire-ios/showcase/<id>/ (import them with tools/import-showcase.py); a look without its own pair uses dark's. Accents are the apps' own (empire-ios Shared/Design: AppAccent; Aresium's red).
